name: LiteLLM
what: The docs state that self-hosted LiteLLM runs no telemetry. On import, the library downloads the latest model cost map from raw.githubusercontent.com.

steps: Set LITELLM_LOCAL_MODEL_COST_MAP=True to use the cost map bundled with the package. The value is compared case-insensitively with "true".
Alternatively, LITELLM_MODEL_COST_MAP_URL can point to a mirror that you control. This check does not read it.
Callbacks that you configure (for example Langfuse or PostHog) send data by design and are not checked.
